items.body: توقع غريب من الأسطورة فاجأ محمد نور، أسطورة الكرة السعودية، الجميع، بعدما توقع فوز فريق الاتحاد ببطولة كأس السوبر السعودي 2026، رغم عدم مشاركته فيها. وتُقام بطولة كأس السوبر السعودي في الكويت، خلال الفترة من 19 إلى 23 ديسمبر/كانون الأول المقبل، بمشاركة 4 فرق؛ هي النصر والخلود والأهلي والقادسية. وظهر محمد نور في مقطع فيديو عبر حساب برنامج "نادينا" على موقع "إكس"، سُئل فيه عن توقعاته للفائزين بالألقاب في المملكة العربية السعودية خلال الموسم الحالي. وقال أسطورة الكرة السعودية إنه يتوقع تتويج الاتحاد بجميع البطولات التي يشارك فيها، وهي دوري روشن وكأس خادم الحرمين الشريفين ودوري أبطال آسيا للنخبة. تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشتر تذكرتك الآن! لكن الأغرب عند سؤاله عن بطل كأس السوبر السعودي، حيث قال إن الاتحاد سيكون البطل أيضًا، رغم أنه لا يشارك في البطولة. ولا يعيش "العميد" أفضل أوقاته، بدءًا من دوري روشن السعودي، حيث يحتل الفريق المركز الرابع في جدول الترتيب برصيد 20 نقطة، بفارق 5 نقاط خلف القادسية، صاحب الصدارة، الذي خاض مباراة أكثر. كما يحتل الفريق الجداوي المركز الحادي عشر في مجموعة الغرب ببطولة دوري أبطال آسيا للنخبة، برصيد نقطة وحيدة، حصدها من تعادل وهزيمة، دون أن يحقق أي انتصار حتى الآن. في عيون محمد نور ◀️ الاتحاد بطل الرباعية 🏆🏆🏆🏆 @MohamedNoor_N18 #دوري_روشن_السعودي #نا…

items.title: Disgraced eMudhra drops out of TLS business after using cert private key of 4
items.summary: Flubbed key signing "ceremony" allowed minting of web credentials for any site.
items.body: eMudra, the certificate authority that issued eight intermediate TLS credentials so weak that anyone could mint certificates for any website or mail server—one had a private encryption key of just 4—said it’s getting out of the business. V. Srinivasan, chairman of India-based eMudhra Limited, cited increasing costs and complexities of compliance requirements—paired with the business generating just 1 percent of its revenue. He also said that the emergence of organizations providing TLS certificates free of charge further reduced returns on investment when compared to other products and services the company offers. Don't let the door hit you on the butt “However, the level of social media amplification around this incident has brought scrutiny that is out of proportion to SSL/TLS’s place in our business,” the company continued in a Thursday post. “In view of this, after detailed deliberations our board has concluded that withdrawing from global SSL/TLS is the right decision for eMudhra and its shareholders.” Read full article Comments

items.title: Leaked Mass Effect: Universe trailer gives a taste of what we're all missing
items.summary: We can't have nice things, but at least we can get trailers for them.
items.body: Those mourning yesterday's shuttering of highly praised and influential developer BioWare also had to deal with the cancellation of the next Mass Effect game, which was first teased back in 2020 . Today, we got our best look at what that game could have been with a short, leaked trailer for Mass Effect: Universe . In the roughly two-minute montage—which describes itself as "in-engine footage from our small team" that "uses our pre-production assets"—an ex-military officer wearing an N7 trenchcoat (similar to the one seen in that 2020 teaser) encounters an Asari at a bar. He talks of his frustration with military life—"by the time you put out one fire, another had already started"—before discussing his new line of work "stopping [the fires] before they start" and "making the choices no one else is willing to make. items.title: Ink droplets in motion snag top prize in Nikon Small World contest
items.summary: Ole Bielfeldt of Germany captured a microscopic view of an inkjet printer depositing ink onto paper.
items.body: A 25-year-old German experimental photographer has won the 2026 Nikon Small World photomicrography competition with a striking image of droplets of ink being deposited on paper by an inkjet printer. Ole Bielfeldt beat out 1,802 other entries hailing from 69 different countries. Bielfeldt became interested in photomicrography during the COVID-19 lockdown after discovering an old microscope in his parents' attic. He figured out how to build an adaptor out of a tube and some wood to connect the microscope to his father's camera and taught himself the art through trial and error, building custom tools as needed. He documents how he captures transformative images of everyday objects with behind-the-scenes videos posted to macrofying , his photography and videography brand. It was Bielfeldt's curiosity about the inner workings of inkjet printers that inspired his winning entry, but capturing the action of ink drops being deposited on paper was a challenge, given that the process happens so quickly. items.title: "Disillusioned" MAHA leader quits as Trump admin's food agenda spoils: Report
items.summary: The departure comes amid turmoil in Kennedy's Make America Healthy Again movement.
items.body: Calley Means—a top ally to anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and a co-author of the so-called "MAHA bible"—resigned from his role in the Trump administration Thursday, reportedly in frustration over delays to food policy changes sought by the Make America Healthy Again movement. "I am resigning from the White House with tremendous respect for President Trump and Bobby Kennedy," Means wrote in a social media post this afternoon . "It was an honor to advocate for MAHA moms in the administration and steer policies like Dietary Guidelines reform, psychedelic reform, removing soda from SNAP, removing food dyes, GRAS reform, and overhauling government food procurement." His post did not provide a reason for his departure. Means served as a senior advisor to Kennedy. Read full article Comments

items.summary: 460 kW charging and 450 miles of range are among the reasons the EV is the one to get.
items.body: BMW provided flights from Washington, DC, to Los Angeles and accommodation so Ars could drive the new X5 and iX5, as well as a refreshed i7 (which you can read about soon). Ars does not accept paid editorial content. When we first drove BMW’s first Neue Klasse model, the iX3 , it quickly revealed that BMW knows how to make a good electric vehicle. A clean-sheet design, it featured the automaker’s sixth-generation electric powertrain , a completely reimagined dashboard, and powerful computers to run the whole show. Now, much of that technology is being ported over to the larger X5 line. But BMW knows not all its customers are ready to go electric, especially in the US, so it’s sticking with its powertrain-agnostic CLAR platform, as used in cars as diverse as the large 7 Series and the new gasoline 3 Series. Which means in addition to the all-electric iX5, there are also mild hybrid and plug-in hybrid X5s available, and in time, even a hydrogen-powered option. For now, as I’ll explain, I think the EV is the pick of the bunch. Get used to it, because this is what BMW SUV kidney grilles look like from now on. items.title: Samsung all but confirms iPhone Duo is goosing Galaxy Z8 sales
items.summary: Searches for Samsung foldables just happened to skyrocket following iPhone Duo unveiling.
items.body: Android-powered foldable phones have been available for years, but most people never paid attention to them. As predicted, that could be changing now that Apple has entered the folding phone market with the iPhone Duo . Analysts have speculated that Samsung's Z8 foldables were seeing a boost from the iPhone announcement, and now Samsung has seemingly confirmed that. In a new blog post , Samsung UK crows that the company's 2026 foldable lineup is moving much faster than last year's models. Compared to the Galaxy Z Fold 7, combined European sales for the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra are up 45 percent. Samsung isn't talking about Z Flip 8 sales, but it previously noted that its larger foldables made up about 80 percent of foldable purchases. We can assume any increase there is not impressive enough to mention. The reason for flat Z Flip sales may simply be that Apple didn't release a flip phone. Unsurprisingly, Samsung doesn't mention Apple or the iPhone Duo in its press release. items.title: US-backed vaccine trial on babies canceled after international outcry
items.summary: The decried trial was canceled last week before police seized vaccine doses.
items.body: Government officials in Guinea-Bissau have formally rejected a clinical trial that would be run by Danish researchers and funded by the US to look for alleged nonspecific harms from the newborn dose of the hepatitis B vaccine. The vaccine dose is currently recommended globally for all newborns and has been used safely and effectively for decades. In an email to Ars Technica, one of the trial's lead researchers, Christine Stabell Benn of Bandim Health Project and the University of Southern Denmark, said that Guinea-Bissau's Council of Ministers "formally reaffirmed its non-acceptance of the study on 16 October." The revelation that the study was formally rejected last week comes after news on Monday that judicial police in Guinea-Bissau raided Bandim Health's offices and seized vaccines . Stabell Benn highlighted that the police search came after the trial was rejected. Read full article Comments

items.title: This emulator reimagines Nintendo’s Virtual Boy with a full color display
items.summary: Tile-based color palettes go way beyond the four shades of red on original hardware.
items.body: Last year, we reported on Red Viper , a Virtual Boy emulator that added a splash of Super Game Boy-style color to Nintendo's famously failed red-on-black "portable" 3D headset from the '90s. Now, a new emulation experiment, VBoy Color , has taken the concept to a higher level, using a tile-based palette system that allows for many more distinct colors in each individual Virtual Boy frame. Rather than simply replacing the Virtual Boy's four shades of red with four different colors, VBoy Color's readme files explain how the emulator's game-specific Color Packs can assign a distinct four-color palette to each 8x8 tile in a Virtual Boy scene. That means the emulator can differentiate between green pipes, grey platforms, and red brick wall in Mario Clash , for instance, even though all those in-game objects share the same overlapping red hues in the original game. The Game Boy Color-esque results feel like being transported into an alternate history where Nintendo invested in a full-color display rather than cheaper red LEDs for the Virtual Boy hardware. items.title: 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email
items.summary: For 3 days this month, 333 exit nodes were hacked in hopes of stealing sensitive data.
items.body: Unknown hackers hijacked more than 300 Tor exit nodes and reconfigured them to favor unencrypted email traffic and redirect SSH connections through servers they controlled, a researcher reported Tuesday. The hijacking began in late August, when, according to Tor volunteers , the attacker used a valid password that had been reused to gain access to a Tor management server. The attacker then installed Ebury , a backdoor written for Linux that was discovered 12 years ago. Mysteries remain Then the attacker connected from the management server to a second Tor server, called Switzerland2, through SSH, using an RSA key that, for unknown reasons, investigators couldn’t find among Switzerland2’s authorized keys. With administrative control of Switzerland2, the attackers installed Ebury there as well. Finally, the attacker reconfigured settings on two exit nodes that Switzerland2 hosted. items.title: UN says we're going to blow past 1.5º warming, offers a "now what?" answer
items.summary: Best case is now an overshoot to 1.8º C, accompanied by massive carbon removal.
items.body: In 2015, all but two countries agreed to make an effort to keep global temperatures from reaching 1.5° C above pre-industrial readings. Since then, most of the world has largely treated what they signed on to as aspirational, and one of the largest emitters (the US) has alternately withdrawn and recommitted to the agreement. Meanwhile, the planet has responded as expected to steadily rising carbon emissions and appears to be practically at the 1.5° limit. On Wednesday, for the first time, the United Nations Environmental Programme (UNEP) acknowledged that reality and conceded that the goal of keeping warming below 1.5° was no longer a viable one. Instead, its new goalposts focus on keeping both how long we exceed that limit and how much we exceed it by, at a minimum. Doing that will require both dramatic emissions cuts now and the removal of hundreds of gigatonnes of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere before the century is out. Carr's post on X said, "Many journalists and broadcasters have been amplifying or airing these Polls without regard to basic journalistic ethics and without informing the public that those Polls lack a scientific, accurate, or even real basis... Broadcasters are advised to avoid engaging in News Distortions or running Broadcast Hoaxes by airing Polls that would violate their regulatory obligations." items.title: Enterprises keep buying software upgrades that IT thinks will make things worse

items.body: Enterprise-sized businesses spend, on average, 28 percent of their software budgets on unwanted upgrades, migrations, and licensing changes. Often, those firms' IT heads think those changes are detrimental. Those results are according to a survey of 2,018 chief information officers and senior IT decision-makers at companies with at least 10,000 employees that Origina commissioned for its report, “ The Software Tax .” About half of the respondents (1,011) are from the US, and the rest are from the United Kingdom. All respondents worked at companies with at least $1 billion in annual revenue. Keep in mind that Origina provides maintenance for various enterprise software. Its report points to independent software maintenance as a way for IT leaders to regain control over software budgets, illustrating its potential bias. items.body: Tesla published its third-quarter 2026 financial results this afternoon. Earlier in October, it reported its sales and deliveries for the three-month period, selling fewer cars than in the same quarter in 2025 , yet it still beat analyst projections. Now we can see how those sales translate to the bottom line. Tesla brought in $28 billion in revenue in Q3, almost the same as in 2025. Automotive revenues were $20.6 billion, a 3 percent decrease year over year. Perhaps more troubling is the decline in revenue from solar panels and storage batteries—this line of business had been growing, but for Q3 revenue fell 16 percent year over year to $2.9 billion. Services and other revenues, though, which include parts and Supercharger use, grew by a third to $4.6 billion. But the company—like the rest of us—has seen its expenses go up. Operating expenses rose by 39 percent to $4.8 billion, dropping the company’s operating margin to just 2.6 percent; in Q3 2025, Tesla’s margin was 5.8 percent. Net profit fell to $787 million, down 43 percent year over year. What’s more, capital expenditures were up by 110 percent to $4.7 billion, and free cash flow was down 62 percent to $1.5 billion.
